parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: 1-128 printable ASCII characters, a client-generated UUID per logical submit (a retry reuses it). A repeated key with the same method, path and body returns the stored response with Idempotency-Replayed: true; with a different method, path or body it is 409 idempotency-key-reused. Missing is 400 idempotency-key-required; malformed is 400 idempotency-key-invalid.
